firm_data.firm_description: Finz & Finz, P.C. is a full-service law firm that fights for maximum compensation in New York, assisting those who suffer tragic injuries through the neglect of others.
notable_facts: Founded by former New York State Supreme Court Justice Leonard L. Finz in 1984.
Recognized as one of New York's most preeminent personal injury, medical malpractice and product liability law firms.
Obtained 4 of the top 20 personal injury settlements in New York in 2020.

founders.name: Leonard L. Finz
founders.title: Founder and Former NYS Supreme Court Justice

email.subject: AI for Finz & Finz - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Cheri,

Founded by a former New York State Supreme Court Justice, Finz & Finz has secured 4 of the top 20 personal injury settlements in New York in 2020. That track record speaks to your team's skill, but it also signals the demands you're managing with a 9-attorney firm.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the New York region to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by Mineola on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
